description: Historical MTP serving results and the original four-variant summary, preserved before the batching fixes and before replacement of the main result files. These are historical measurements, not results for the final runtime.
measurement_scope: The preserved summary covers all four historical serving variants. The preserved raw requests, metadata, and chat smoke output in this directory are for historical ISQ MTP only; the other variants remain in the parent raw directory.
copy_validation: Each copied file SHA-256 matches the source, which was read again after copying to detect concurrent changes.
